entry.title: New: Resolution 344 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS FROM LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A LICENSING AGREEMENT FOR PROPRIETARY COMPUTER SOFTWARE AND RELATED SERVICES TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year agreement with an approximate annual cost of $934,000, for continued use of the Microsoft Enterprise Agreement program necessary for numerous County functions and operations.
